article.title: Measures to prevent unfair trade practices in e-commerce, direct selling, etc.
article.content:
94Measures to prevent unfair trade practices in e-commerce, direct selling, etc.

Section 94  ·  Chapter VIII  ·  page 34 of the Act
For the purposes of preventing unfair trade practices in e-commerce, direct selling and also to protect the interest and rights of consumers, the Central Government may take such measures in the manner as may be prescribed.
